$comment: A YAML document that parses cleanly to a top-level sequence rather than a mapping, the shape a copy-paste error into the wrong block style produces.

The yaml package accepts this as valid YAML, so parse.ok is true; parseWorkflow's own guard then reduces it to an empty workflow object because a sequence carries no jobs or on block to read, so all thirteen elements score missing the ordinary way. actionlint refuses the same document with three syntax-check findings naming the missing on and jobs sections and the wrong node kind, which is why maxLintFindings and not maxParseFailures is the ceiling this case breaches: the file is syntactically valid YAML and semantically not a workflow.
derivation: A YAML document that parses cleanly to a top-level sequence rather than a mapping, the shape a copy-paste error into the wrong block style produces.

The yaml package accepts this as valid YAML, so parse.ok is true; parseWorkflow's own guard then reduces it to an empty workflow object because a sequence carries no jobs or on block to read, so all thirteen elements score missing the ordinary way. actionlint refuses the same document with three syntax-check findings naming the missing on and jobs sections and the wrong node kind, which is why maxLintFindings and not maxParseFailures is the ceiling this case breaches: the file is syntactically valid YAML and semantically not a workflow.

findings.message: "workflow" section is sequence node but mapping node is expected
